title: Multi-task learning for the automatic grading of enlarged perivascular space burden using MRI
abstract: arXiv:2609.37387v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Enlarged perivascular spaces (PVS) visible in brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are increasingly thought to be linked to poor brain health. PVS are elongated structures of less than 3 mm in diameter and can be numerous. To reflect the incidence of PVS, radiologists visually score their burden following a clinical grading scale - a task that would benefit from automation to accelerate analyses and overcome the influence of inter-observer differences. We developed and evaluated methods for training machine learning models to score PVS incidence in the basal ganglia (BG) and centrum semiovale (CSO) leveraging the Potters/Wardlaw scale. The novelty in our work lies in the use of imperfect, semi-automatically generated "silver-standard" PVS segmentation masks during training, in addition to PVS radiological scores. translated_title: 基于MRI的多任务学习用于扩张血管周围间隙负担的自动分级
translated_abstract: 脑部磁共振成像（MRI）中可见的扩张血管周围间隙（PVS）越来越被认为与大脑健康状况不佳有关。PVS是直径小于3毫米的细长结构，且数量可能很多。为了反映PVS的发生情况，放射科医生会根据临床分级量表对其负担进行视觉评分——这项任务若能实现自动化，将有助于加速分析并克服观察者间差异的影响。我们开发并评估了训练机器学习模型的方法，利用Potters/Wardlaw量表对基底神经节（BG）和半卵圆中心（CSO）中的PVS发生率进行评分。我们工作的创新之处在于，在训练过程中除了使用PVS放射学评分外，还使用了不完美的、半自动生成的“银标准”PVS分割掩码。我们比较评估了一种条件卷积神经网络（CNN），该网络接受PVS掩码作为额外的输入通道。
tldr: 本文提出一种多任务学习方法，在训练中同时利用临床PVS评分和半自动生成的“银标准”分割掩码，实现了基于MRI的基底神经节和半卵圆中心扩张血管周围间隙负担的自动分级。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-task learning approach that leverages both clinical PVS scores and imperfect semi-automatically generated "silver-standard" segmentation masks during training to automatically grade enlarged perivascular space burden in the basal ganglia and centrum semiovale using MRI.
